title: The Kong admin API is reachable
summary: The Kong admin API answers unauthenticated, which is full control of the gateway: its routes, services and plugins.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("plugins") and body_contains("available_on_server") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Never expose the Kong admin API; bind it to localhost or require authentication.
